label: TP
reason: Assessed alert path: User input from request parameter flows into valuesList, removes the first element ('safe'), and retrieves the second element (which holds the original user input) into bar. The bar variable is then placed into an Object array and formatted directly into the HTTP response writer. The resolved sink value is attacker-controlled user input, making this a true positive XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: User param added to list, first element removed, second element (original param) retrieved into bar and written to response.
